title: Ryohei Oiwa’s Big Dream
summary: Ryohei Oiwa turns a G1 breakthrough into a challenge to Yota Tsuji’s championship. This chapter remains open at the archive cutoff, with their title match signed but not yet held.

chapters.title: Oiwa wins the G1
chapters.result: Oiwa defeats Uemura to win the tournament.
chapters.context: The final between two rising stars gives Oiwa his route to the IWGP championship.

chapters.title: Oiwa and Tsuji sign the contract
chapters.result: The champion and challenger make their October 12 title match official.
chapters.context: Oiwa seeks to reverse his G1 loss to Tsuji. Only the contract signing is indexed here; the future match has no recorded result in this archive.
